response.justification: While Bogdan demonstrates exceptional 20-year software engineering experience with strong infrastructure and cloud capabilities, he lacks the specialized AI/ML expertise central to this director-level AI strategy role. The position explicitly requires recognized expertise in AI with demonstrated AI products or platforms—his recent AI infrastructure work at re:cinq (2025-present) is promising but too nascent and tangential to substantiate the deep AI domain specialization expected. General software excellence does not substitute for the focused AI strategy expertise this role demands.
strengths: 20+ years of progressive software engineering experience exceeds 15-year requirement with demonstrated full-stack capabilities across web, mobile, infrastructure, and embedded systems
Current role involves AI-agent infrastructure and MCP frameworks, showing recent strategic pivot toward AI domain with relevant hands-on exposure
Strong entrepreneurial and mentorship track record including GISCollective open-source platform, technical workshops, and multiple senior/staff engineering positions
concerns: No Master's degree or PhD in AI-related field; lacks the preferred specialized academic credential for AI strategy leadership
No demonstrated recognized expertise or shipped AI products; career primarily focused on general software engineering rather than AI specialization or innovation
Insufficient AI domain depth and duration (~1.3 years in current role); too recent and peripheral to validate director-level AI strategy expertise
